reference_field.spatial_coordinates: per-frame current Lagrangian cell centres; queries are interpolated within the material block each query point belongs to at that frame
reference_field.method: 1D spherical Lagrangian finite volume, staggered, von Neumann-Richtmyer viscosity
reference_field.initial_condition: scheme A: whole charge converts at t=0 (uniform, at rest, e = E0/rho0)

check_set.label: independent-check
check_set.purpose: fixed physics verification and model selection; never in a gradient
check_set.selection_criteria: lexicographic, fixed before the final test set is seen: (1) non-physical / inadmissible state count, (2) squared hinge of the physics and interface residuals against the section 16 tolerances, (3) development-set prediction error, (4) training loss. Lower is better at every level.
